expected_behavior: run_db_check must never return exit 0 when its final database-check envelope is failure-class. Existing nonzero verdict/error statuses remain nonzero, while success-class results retain their reported status.
spec_queries: failure-class result must not exit zero
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_04.rs b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_04.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_04.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let main_source = include_str!("../src/main.rs");
+    let db_check = main_source
+        .split_once("fn run_db_check(")
+        .expect("run_db_check exists")
+        .1
+        .split_once("\nfn run_db_observe(")
+        .expect("run_db_check has a following function")
+        .0;
+    assert!(
+        db_check.contains(
+            "status.max(i32::from(!outcome_class(&output).is_success()))"
+        ),
+        "run_db_check must conserve the final envelope's failure class in its exit status"
+    );
+
+    let outcome_source = include_str!("../src/outcome.rs");
+    assert!(outcome_source.contains("_ => OutcomeClass::Failure"));
+}
